name: Kyonyuu Shokudou Harami Teishoku ~Ore Dake no Ura Menu!?~
original_name: 巨乳食堂孕み定食 ～俺だけの裏メニュー!?～
source:
I came back to my hometown after three years since I left to find a job.

Taking a break working myself to death, I wanted to spend some time at the place where I was born and raised.

Old people, nostalgic scenery. But there were still a lot of things that have changed over the years.

That's why I was really happy when I found the old private restaurant "Ippai" still going strong in downtown.

When I entered, there was a glamorous and beautiful waitress who greeted me.

The bosom and smile that hadn't changed. However, there was something different.

Her husband, who was the shop owner and the main chef, had died, and now it seemed that together with her daughter, there were only two people managed the restaurant.

The daughter was also completely grown up, I was completely captivated by both of them.

Here's the place of rest that I was looking for!

And so, the days to deepen your friendship with a beautiful busty mother and daughter begin!

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=924723]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
离开家乡外出谋职三年后，我回到了故乡。

暂时从拼命工作的生活中抽身，我想在自己出生、长大的地方度过一段时光。

老人、熟悉的景色，一切都令人怀念。但这些年里，也有许多事物发生了变化。

所以，当我发现市中心那家老字号家庭餐馆“Ippai”依然在营业时，实在开心极了。

我走进店里，一位身姿丰腴、容貌秀美的女服务员迎了上来。

她的胸脯和笑容一如往昔，可还有些事情变了。

身为店主兼主厨的丈夫已经去世，如今似乎只剩她和女儿两人经营餐馆。

女儿也已经完全长大，我被这对母女深深吸引。

这就是我一直在寻找的休憩之所！

就这样，与美丽丰满的母女加深关系的日子开始了！

（译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=924723]Getchu[/url]）
